title: Briefing for 2026-10-21
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-21: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes. India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit. U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all. Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done. U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting.
global: Marseille braces for more unrest after protests give way to 'apocalyptic' disorder. Trump and Zelensky appear at loggerheads despite Oslo optimism. Alberta's decisive decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump. Sudan army drones hit mourners and fuel market killing more than 300 people, sources say. UK government to make Jackdaw gas field announcement. Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge.
philippines: Three issues defining the 2026 US midterm elections. France to deploy troops, admits to failures over weekend unrest. Parts of Northern Luzon to be rainy as Super Typhoon Rosal speeds up. Padayon Cebu: A new space to chat how to make the province more livable.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
